name: frontend-slides
tagline_zh: 把PPT丢进来，眨眼变成带动画的网页幻灯片。不用选模板，靠视觉探索找到你的审美，连非设计师也能做出惊艳演示。
tagline_en: Drop a PPT, get animated web slides. No template picking—explore visuals to find your style, even if you're not a.
desc_en: Create stunning, animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. Use when the user wants to build a presentation, convert a PPT/PPTX to web, or create slides for a talk/pitch. Helps non-designers discover their aesthetic through visual exploration rather than abstract choices.
why_zh: 同类工具让你选模板，它让你直接看效果。从PPT转换到动画生成，全程视觉驱动，审美零门槛。
why_en: Others make you choose templates; this one shows you live previews. Visual-first, PPT-to-animation, zero design skill needed.
